blockers.fix: Add loop-guard headers (Auto-Submitted, X-Invespend-Notification, own Message-ID) to legacy build_approval_email as headers only (subject/body unchanged). Legacy pipeline ignores inbound mail carrying them or whose own Message-ID is ours BEFORE any token/ref lookup. Drop S10's 'new builders only' wording. Test: render approval email for one and two pendings, parse with inbox.parse_message, feed run_approval_cycle -> nothing executed, records pending, audit own_notification.

blockers.issue: S7 HTML typed region = 'text nodes not inside a quote/forward container'; Outlook/OWA divRplyFwdMsg wraps only the header block, forwarded body is a sibling AFTER it -> counted typed with confident=True -> third-party 'pay 450' triggers; same for stray or bottom-posting.
blockers.fix: typed_text = ONLY text BEFORE the first container/marker start in document order; everything after the first boundary is non-typed regardless of nesting. Tests: OWA forward fixture (divRplyFwdMsg header + sibling body with 'pay 123') -> no trigger; stray before third-party 'pay 123' -> ignored; text below gmail_quote -> not typed.

blockers.issue: Cancel fails open: (a) B8 inbound ignore covers References/Message-ID containing our id so every reply to our hold email is ignored; (b) every reply has In-Reply-To so B3 requires a confident split; Outlook desktop replies unsplittable -> typed_text='' -> cancel dropped; (c) T10 whole-line rule drops 'Cancel please'. Held payment executes.
blockers.fix: Loop guard matches only the message's OWN Message-ID and Auto-Submitted/X-Invespend headers, never References/In-Reply-To. Cancel fails SAFE: authenticated mail resolving to exactly one active ref with 'cancel' as first non-empty line of the RAW body is accepted even if split not confident. Authenticated mail with valid ref and no recognised command gets a 'not understood; executes at <execute_after>; reply cancel' notice. Tests: cancel reply with In-Reply-To/References = our id -> cancelled; unsplittable Outlook-style 'cancel' -> cancelled; 'Cancel please' -> not-understood email sent+audited.
